notes: Crunchyroll, Sobreviví, Saving Hope, and Stromberg all resolved through jmp2.uk and were rejected at the provenance gate before media validation.

I Survived used an unlinked CloudFront source. Rights-holder programme availability was found, but no authoritative evidence tied that exact live source to the canonical channel, so it remained identity-unresolved and quarantined.
No source entered expensive playback validation and no production write, duplicate, or cache mutation occurred.
